evidence: BridgeController registers the scheduler hotkey only from SetEnabled(true).
TrayApplicationContext currently calls SetEnabled only from the manual tray ToggleClicked handler.
Program constructs TrayApplicationContext but does not enable the bridge.
run-stage12-real-instant.ps1 starts WorkspaceOperator but does not toggle or request bridge enablement.
At Q1 the operator observed Ctrl+Space fall through to the Linux terminal as ^@ and the clipboard retained the previously copied Windows-ready marker.
root_cause.consequence: The Q1 dispatch path never ran. Clipboard and Firefox foreground behavior were not exercised; the v1.0 foreground fallback is therefore not disproven by this attempt.

design_goal: Reduce redesign validation to a fast Windows-only local loop, with explicit lifecycle controls, before any costly Linux/Tailscale/PostgreSQL/real-account Stage-12 run.

proposed_changes.behavior: Add an explicit --bridge-start-enabled startup switch. Stage-12 and the dev harness pass it. Startup must fail closed if global hotkey registration fails.
proposed_changes.safety: Default non-remote behavior remains OFF unless the explicit switch is present.

proposed_changes.behavior: Add an explicit development-only local smoke action port that creates one synthetic CREATE_AND_SERVICE action with a known content-free test packet. This exercises browser binding creation, clipboard write, final browser focus, and the native foreground fallback without Linux/Tailscale/PostgreSQL.
proposed_changes.safety: Available only under an explicit smoke-mode CLI switch; no remote authority, credentials, DOM/page-content access, automatic paste, or automatic submission.

proposed_changes.behavior: Add workspace-operator-dev.ps1 with start, stop, reset, status, and smoke actions. Reuse incremental build output and a dedicated dev-only Firefox profile so repeated UI iterations do not re-clone, recreate the Python environment, start PostgreSQL, configure Tailscale, or require a new ChatGPT login every time.
proposed_changes.safety: The persistent profile is dedicated to this dev harness only and is never the user's daily Firefox profile.

proposed_changes.behavior: Stage-12 Windows launcher must pass --bridge-start-enabled and print a dedicated HOTKEY_REGISTERED/BRIDGE_ENABLED readiness marker only after the helper remains alive after registration.
proposed_changes.safety: Linux live-consumption remains blocked until the Windows readiness gate includes this startup proof.

proposed_changes.behavior: For production, separate a tiny always-on per-user supervisor from the dispatch bridge. Expose typed status/online/offline/restart controls through the Workspace control plane/plugin, analogous to Heartbeat. 'Offline' disables dispatch and unregisters the hotkey without removing the supervisor, avoiding a remote-start chicken-and-egg problem.
proposed_changes.safety: No generic shell control, no arbitrary process execution, no admin service requirement, and no widening of model execution authority.

proposed_changes.behavior: The fast lifecycle stop/reset path owns exact process shutdown and bounded retry of its work directory, eliminating the observed SharedContracts.dll cleanup race from the giant outer Stage-12 wrapper.
proposed_changes.safety: Only recorded process IDs/work directories/native-host registry state owned by the dev runtime are changed.

fast_loop_acceptance: One Windows command starts or resets the dev runtime.
No Linux terminal, sudo, Tailscale route, PostgreSQL, Python venv, Git clone, or candidate branch is required for hotkey/clipboard/foreground smoke testing.
The helper proves the bridge is enabled and global hotkey registration succeeded before declaring ready.
One Ctrl+Space causes a known smoke packet to replace the clipboard and brings the dedicated Firefox window to OS foreground.
A stop command returns helper/Firefox/dev state to a known clean state.
A status command reports source SHA, helper state, Firefox state, bridge enabled state, and smoke readiness without page-content access.

authority_gate.authority_evidence: Owner capsule allowed_mutation_scope includes operator-bridge/**, operator-bridge tests, and operator-bridge validation workflow on workspace-semantic-execution-migration-v1.
